description: Versioned wire schema identifiers shared by kbox and krun. These strings are duplicated by hand in both repositories; this list is the machine-readable contract that scripts/check-wire-contracts.py enforces. Adding, renaming or removing any wire identifier requires editing this file in the same change.

kbox_only.kbox.engine.journal.v1: kbox-internal engine journal record; never sent to krun
kbox_only.kbox.engine.prewarm.v1: kbox-internal prewarm schedule record; never sent to krun

krun_only.krun.capability-package.v1: krun-owned capability package schema; kbox only consumes the guest-installation envelope
krun_only.krun.guest-runtime.v1: krun-owned guest runtime inventory schema; not part of the engine wire protocol
krun_only.capability-packages.v1: Legacy consumer-owned business assembly/installation contract; removed from the generic kbox engine in the accepted release baseline.
